summary: Spectrum Business (Charter Communications) markets dedicated fiber internet, unified communications, and managed network/edge security services specifically to restaurant operators, citing a case study in which a multi-location pizza chain resolved POS bandwidth issues and lost takeout-order/outage problems by upgrading to Dedicated Fiber Internet plus Unified Communications and Managed Network Edge. (Scope note: Case study restaurant chain is not named in the source; treat as an illustrative, not brand-specific, customer example.)
